answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring a refundable stake before an agent may trade on the shared terrace marketplace. New identities start with zero reputation and must earn standing through completed, verifiable work, so spawning thousands of fakes ties up real capital. A random echo audit then asks past counterparties to confirm an agent's claimed history; unconfirmed claims trigger stake slashing and revocation. Like a zephyr clearing smoke, these spot checks expose cheap fakery before it can extract value, while honest agents keep their stake and build trust.
